title: The Rift in the Alliance Manifests
next_chapter_hook: The truth spilled by the betrayer before his death sent a chill down Chen Ji's spine—the mastermind behind it all had countless connections to Mo Xiansheng.

text.content: The ancient scroll fragment's runes resonated eerily with the Tianji Record, and the familiar patterns made Chen Ji's heart tighten—a design he distinctly remembered seeing in his father's study as a child. The moment his fingertips touched the paper, memories flooded back like a tide: his father Chen Xuan hunched over ancient texts, the flickering lamplight casting shadows as he murmured 'This must never be spread abroad,' and... the mysterious fire that razed their entire household.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul echoed in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, carrying an unprecedented gravity: 'This page... is not the fragment I left you. It comes from a far more distant past— so distant that even I cannot trace its origin. Boy, where exactly did your father obtain the Tianji Record?' Chen Ji offered no reply. His gaze remained fixed on the faintly visible characters inscribed at the heart of the runes—'Heavenly Fate may be stolen, but the heart cannot be defied.'

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's voice sounded at the door, breaking Chen Ji's contemplation: 'Chen Ji, urgent Alliance report— the Holy Sect has mobilized three armies southeastward, intentions unclear.' Her tone carried a rare hint of anxiety. 'There's more... I've received classified intelligence that someone within the Alliance is leaking our information to the Holy Sect.'

Chen Ji tucked the ancient scroll fragment into his sleeve, his expression calm to the point of coldness: 'What intelligence was leaked? When did it start?' Su Qingyao pushed through the door, her gaze lingering on his face as if trying to discern whether he was truly as composed as he appeared. She said heavily: 'Intelligence from three days ago—the Alliance convoy's route. Information known only to core members.'

text.content: 'The route from three days ago... that was top-secret known to only seven people. Su Qingyao, myself, Ling Yuan, the Vice Sect Master, the Xuanwu Sect representative, and... Chen Feng, the Vice Sect Master's personal disciple.' Chen Ji's eyes flickered; a name surfaced in his mind. He didn't immediately respond but instead asked: 'What did the Holy Sect do after receiving the intelligence?'

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao shook her head: 'That's precisely the strange part. The intelligence was leaked, but the Holy Sect made no corresponding military movements—at least not on the surface.' She paused, lowering her voice. 'I suspect... this was a probe. Someone is using real intelligence to test our reaction speed, while simultaneously confirming whether the insider is still operational.'

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled—that expression cold and sharp as frost: 'A probe? Then let their probe become reality.' He stood, walking to the window, gazing at the endless rooftops of the Tianqing Sect. 'I want to see who's courting death on my turf.' Before the words even faded, a completely black homing pigeon landed on the windowsill, a blood-stained bamboo tube tied to its foot.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji opened the bamboo tube and unfolded the slip inside. In an instant, his pupils constricted—that familiar handwriting, the cipher only he and his sister Chen Nian knew: 'Brother, save me. Holy Sect prison, Eastern Sea island, three-day deadline.' Su Qingyao leaned in to glance, her expression shifting slightly: 'This is... Chen Nian?'

text.content: Chen Ji's fingers trembled slightly. For three years he had traversed countless mountains and rivers searching for his sister, countless times risking life and death for a single clue. Now, this letter appeared so abruptly before him. But he was Chen Ji after all—the man who concealed his true self beneath the mask of a废物, secretly maneuvering the world. He drew a deep breath, forcing himself to remain calm: 'This letter... has problems.'

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao blinked: 'You mean... this is fake?' Chen Ji didn't answer directly. Instead, he brought the slip closer to the candle flame for careful examination: 'Chen Nian's cipher was something I agreed upon with her when I was eight, changed every three years. The cipher on this letter... is from ten years ago.' His gaze turned ice-cold. 'Someone knows my and Chen Nian's past, but not that we changed the code later.'

text.content: 'This is a scheme killing two birds with one stone.' Chen Ji set the slip on the table, tapping the surface lightly with his fingertips. 'Using news of Chen Nian to throw us into chaos, while the insider's intelligence leak creates even greater disorder. If I lose my composure because of this letter, I'd fall right into their trap.' His eyes gradually regained clarity; the rage was pressed deep into his pupils, replaced by a chilling calm.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao gazed at his profile, a complex emotion rising within her. This man called a废物 always revealed a terrifying clarity at the most critical moments. She asked: 'What do you intend to do?' A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips: 'Turn the tables. I'll reply to this 'Chen Nian,' while also spreading word that I'm personally going to the Eastern Sea to rescue her.'

text.content: 'You want to draw out the snake.' Su Qingyao immediately grasped his intent. Chen Ji nodded: 'The insider can transmit intelligence, so they're certainly watching my every move. If I 'panic' and leave the Sect, they'll definitely inform the Holy Sect to set an ambush on the way. At that time...' He didn't finish, but the gleam flickering in those eyes said everything.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji set his trap; three days later, the insider's identity surfaced—unexpectedly Chen Feng, the Vice Sect Master's personal disciple. Before ironclad evidence, Chen Feng knelt and begged for mercy, shocking the Alliance's high command. How to dispose of this traitor became a difficult choice before you.

choices.description: Execute Chen Feng publicly before all Alliance members—this can serve as a warning while demonstrating resolve to the Holy Sect. The cost is alerting the enemy, letting the mastermind behind the scenes grow wary.
choices.visible_cost: Alarming the Snake, the Mastermind Grows Wary

text.content: Chen Ji surveyed his surroundings, his gaze finally settling on Su Qingyao's face: 'Public execution.' Four words, each heavy as thunder. 'Let everyone see what happens when one betrays the Alliance.' The news spread, shaking the entire Tianqing Sect. On execution day, the plaza teemed with people; Chen Feng was dragged onto the high platform, his face deathly pale.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji, you've gone mad!' The Vice Sect Master's voice rang out from the crowd, but was quickly drowned by a wave of boos. Chen Ji coldly regarded him: 'Your prized disciple committed treason and defected to the enemy, Vice Sect Master. Do you wish to plead for him, or... face interrogation alongside him?' The Vice Sect Master's face flushed with fury, his lips trembling, yet no words emerged.

choices.memory_label: 公开处决陈风，震慑全宗

choices.description: Spare Chen Feng on the surface, secretly turn him into a tool for transmitting false intelligence. Let the Holy Sect pay the price for incorrect intelligence at a critical moment.
choices.visible_cost: The Longer the Time, the More Variables Multiply
choices.visible_reward: Continuously Control the Information Flow, Make the Holy Sect Suffer Its Own Mischief
choices.risk_hint: Once Exposed, All Leverage Will Be Lost

text.content: Chen Ji leaned down toward the collapsed Chen Feng, his voice low enough for only the two of them: 'Want to live?' Chen Feng nodded frantically, his eyes filled with terror and desperate desire for survival. A cold smile twisted Chen Ji's lips: 'Then continue passing messages to the Holy Sect—except the content will be determined by me.'

dialogue.content: Chen Feng was terrified out of his wits, nodding repeatedly. From that moment, he knew he had completely become a chess piece in Chen Ji's hands—one that could be crushed at any moment. Su Qingyao stood nearby, watching Chen Ji's expression—so calm it was nearly terrifying—and an indescribable emotion stirred within her. This man... how many sides did he have that she still didn't know?

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul spoke in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a barely perceptible fluctuation: 'You've chosen this path... good. The visions the Tianji Record reveals are sometimes not true, but rather... a script woven by Heaven's Way. Be careful, Chen Ji. What you see may not be real; what you don't see may not be false.'

text.content: A script woven by Heaven's Way? Chen Ji's heart lurched. If even the Tianji Record's foresight could be manipulated, then his years of elaborate schemes... He drew a deep breath, suppressing the unease in his heart. No matter what, he had to continue forward. Even if fate was a play already written, he would be the one who rewrites the ending.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao suddenly spoke: 'Chen Ji, there's something I've never asked... that letter from Chen Nian, can you truly be certain it's fake?' Chen Ji was silent for a moment, unfolding the letter again. This time, he examined every detail carefully—the paper's texture, the ink's depth, the strokes' nuances. Suddenly, his pupils contracted slightly.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji discovered something amiss in the forged letter—a thread of Blood Pulse unique only to Chen Nian herself woven within the paper. What did this mean? Did Chen Nian personally write the letter? Or did someone obtain this trace of Blood Pulse from Chen Nian?

choices.description: Confirm Chen Nian's safety no matter what, even if this might fall right into the enemy's trap. Even if there's only a one-in-ten-thousand chance that his sister awaits him.
choices.visible_cost: May Expose One's Own Weaknesses and trump Cards
choices.visible_reward: Find Chen Nian or Confirm Her Safety
choices.risk_hint: The Enemy Is Using This as Bait

text.content: Chen Ji sealed that thread of Blood Pulse within the Tianji Record, closing his eyes in concentration. The Tianji Record blazed with golden light; countless images flashed like a kaleidoscope—the Eastern Sea island, the prison, a weeping woman... but each time a vision approached something crucial, it shattered like a reflection in water. His eyes snapped open, cold sweat beading his forehead: 'Something is interfering with the Tianji Record... it's Chen Nian!'

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice spoke: 'Heavenly Fate's Lock and Key... her very existence can disrupt the Tianji Record. The blurry visions you saw weren't because the prophecy was tampered with, but because she's right beside you. Go, boy. Some truths can only be confirmed through your own eyes.'

choices.description: The more the enemy wants him to panic, the calmer he must be. Set aside Chen Nian's matter for now, focus on the game before him. His sister's situation... he'll address it once he has sufficient strength.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain Strategic Initiative, Don't Be Ruled by Emotions
choices.risk_hint: If Chen Nian Is Truly in Danger, He'll Regret It for Life

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the letter into his chest, his expression returning to calm: 'Chen Nian... I've noted it.' Four words, spoken extremely softly, yet heavy as a thousand pounds. Su Qingyao watched his retreating figure and suddenly felt this man bore far too much weight no man his age should carry. She opened her mouth, wanting to say something, but ultimately it only became a sigh.

dialogue.content: 'You... can really let go?' Su Qingyao asked softly. Chen Ji turned, his eyes showing not the slightest波动: 'Let go? No. I only know... now is not the time.' He gazed at the night sky beyond the window, starlight reflected in his pupils. 'Wait until I've arranged this chess game... even Heaven's Way won't be able to stop me from rescuing her.'

text.content: Night deepened; the lights of the Tianqing Sect gradually extinguished. Chen Ji sat alone by the window, his fingers unconsciously stroking the Tianji Record's cover. His mind replayed the day's events endlessly: the ancient scroll fragment's eerie resonance, Chen Nian's rescue signal, the Alliance insider's exposure, Mo Xiansheng's profound warning... all clues pointed toward an increasingly clear truth—a black hand invisible to him manipulated everything behind this chaos. What disturbed him more was that the aura of that black hand... bore an uncanny resemblance to a certain residual power within the Tianji Record.
